fb.en: Someday I want to travel to Japan.

wsent: I never want to travel to Japan.
I'm travelling to Japan right now.
I travel to Japan every year.
adverbs.note: irgend- makes things indefinite: irgendwann (some time), irgendwo (somewhere), irgendetwas (something).

fb.en: The flight takes at least eight hours.

wsent: The flight takes at most eight hours.
The flight takes exactly eight hours.
The flight rarely takes eight hours.
adverbs.note: Opposite: höchstens (at most). With numbers and quantities: mindestens zehn Minuten.

wsent: Only 200 people registered at first.
On average 200 people register.
Additionally, 200 people registered.
adverbs.note: Sums things up: insgesamt gesehen = all in all. Very common in statistics and reports.

fb.de: Ich kann nicht zwei Dinge _____ tun.
fb.en: I can't do two things at the same time.

wsent: I can't do two things one after another.
I can only do two things immediately.
I never do two things.
adverbs.note: gleich (same) + Zeit (time). Also 'at once both X and Y': Das ist gleichzeitig schön und traurig.

wsent: I completely forgot my key.
I definitely forgot my key.
I barely found my key.
adverbs.note: Synonym of fast. Often with hätte/wäre for near-misses: Ich wäre beinahe gefallen = I almost fell.

wsent: It was mainly a misunderstanding.
It was definitely not a misunderstanding.
It was a serious misunderstanding.
adverbs.note: Formal/written synonym of nur. Downplays: lediglich eine Formalität = just a formality.

wsent: The attempt failed for the first time.
The attempt finally succeeded.
The attempt rarely fails.
adverbs.note: Written/news synonym of wieder/noch einmal. From neu (new). Verb: erneuern (to renew).

fb.de: Im Stau kommen wir nur langsam _____.
fb.en: In the traffic jam we only move forward slowly.

wsent: In the traffic jam we roll backward slowly.
In the traffic jam we don't move at all.
We leave the traffic jam quickly.
adverbs.note: The -wärts family: rückwärts (backward), aufwärts (upward), abwärts (downward), seitwärts (sideways).

wsent: The winter was extremely cold.
The winter was surprisingly long.
The winter has not started yet.
adverbs.note: From der Vergleich (comparison) + -weise. The -weise family: beispielsweise, teilweise, möglicherweise.

wsent: Nothing is right here.
Everything is fine here.
Someone is not right here.
adverbs.note: Colloquial short form: irgendwas. Family: irgendjemand (someone), irgendwo (somewhere), irgendwie (somehow).

fb.de: _____ kommst du jetzt mit, oder du bleibst hier.
fb.en: Either you come along now, or you stay here.

wsent: Neither do you come along, nor do you stay.
You always come along.
You can stay here as long as you like.
adverbs.note: Fixed pair: entweder … oder = either … or. Negative counterpart: weder … noch = neither … nor.

fb.de: Er ist nicht nur klug, _____ auch fleißig.
fb.en: He is not only clever but also hard-working.

wsent: He is clever but lazy.
He is neither clever nor hard-working.
He is clever because he works hard.
adverbs.note: Only after a negation, correcting it: nicht X, sondern Y. 'aber' contrasts without correcting. Fixed phrase: nicht nur … sondern auch.
